assumptions.recoveryAt: Any dead target or HP under 50%
assumptions.selection: All unlocked stages probed from the same saved HP/PRNG, continuous native short campaigns; failures retained; actual campaign chooses fastest successful probe and carries native HP/PRNG.
assumptions.gearMilestones: Starter +0 through Lv.4; crafted +0 at Lv.5; +3 at Lv.10; +6 at Lv.30 and afterward.
synthetic: Initial money budget for recording native costs, not an earned-income claim
Exact materials and money for native paid ascensions; not material-farming time
excluded: Cost of raw crafting ingredients, market prices
assumptions.diagnosticHistory: Keeps the most recent 30 logs and battle receipts in VM to bound diagnostic clone cost; action sequence and actual growth/inventory/HP/PRNG preserved.

costs.leyLimit: One claimed reward per kind per real-time hour shared across regions; party recipients spend books separately; never compare 4-member direct XP to one-owner books without multiplying demand.

lodgingQuoteCorrection.reason: Native inn quote now rounds the integer lost-HP numerator; other campaign outcomes must match exactly.

materialExperienceRole.timingModel: single fight no recovery, 2x-labelled internal1, input3s+reentry6s
materialExperienceRole.conclusion: No measured material stage has greater direct-XP/minute than the best measured EXP stage. This is a single-seed comparison, not an all-party/all-seed proof. Material XP and EXP requirement curves remain unchanged.
materialExperienceRole.provenance: Measurements made before the final inn-only integer rounding correction; no additional combat-stage probes were run for that correction. Early rows retain their prior budget observation, with every affected Lv50/55/60 stage rechecked after the final durability freeze.

expenseScope: Actual native lodging payments are measured. Ascension materials/Mora and equipment/talents are fixtures, with authoritative requirements/analytic enhancement expectation listed separately. This is pure EXP cultivation time with lodging/travel, not an integrated total including every material/ore/Mora/quest activity. Growth material XP must credit the same band before adding its farming time; do not double-count that XP.
hourBucketTiming: Each kind pays once in a real-time hour bucket, shared across regions. N claims occupy N distinct hour buckets. If first claim is just before the boundary, elapsed wait can approach max(0,N-2) hours; first/last bucket index difference is N-1 hours. Add actual battle/travel time; these are opportunity bounds, not a guarantee of affordability or victory.

selectionProbeProvenance.interpretation: Primary stage-selection probes are prior observations. Final campaigns rerun all selected fights, recoveries and movement with the unchanged current source and reuse those decisions. Original probe metrics are not represented as newly sampled final-source candidates.

historicalObservations.reason: Final inn quote integer-arithmetic correction only; all native replay wins, losses, time, phase Mora and final HP required exact agreement. Prior selected-stage probe metrics are reused historical observations, not new final-source probes.

gearEnhancementModel.formula: increment[t] = (mora[t] + downProbability[t] * increment[t-1]) / successProbability[t]; expected[target] = sum(increment[1..target])

financeInterpretation: Recorded initial wallet and exact ascension items/Mora are synthetic diagnostic funding. Native lodging and phase payments are expenses, never earned-income claims. Four participants simultaneously receive direct XP; book allocation is per owner. No final book/wealth cooldown or quest income is projected as free, immediate funding. New Lv55 wish character repays final phase only.

fullTrace.contains: Every final native EXP battle with HP before/after, every recovery movement/quote/payment, phase payments, cached stage-probe metrics with original source provenance, both newcomer campaigns, the historical +10 failure, complete material-XP role candidate metrics, and the prior source totals/repriced quote history.
